title: STALKERS
body:
![STALKERS_MOD](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/edb341be54b60b20cbff4a37a33f707206910c8a.png)Stalkers (Forge 1.20.1)

Stalkers is a minimal anomaly-based mod that introduces observing entities and unstable dimensions.
The mod focuses on perception rather than combat.

⸻

Entities:

Watcher — keeps distance, appears in view, disappears on direct focus.
Corner — manifests near edges and corners, rarely fully visible.
Mimic — imitates familiar shapes with subtle inconsistencies.

⸻
![BEHIND](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/86fce45526a16456cdffd9af1690729b526e2073.jpeg)

Dimensions:

The mod includes isolated, unstable dimensions with altered behavior:

inconsistent layout
distorted lighting
unreliable spatial cues

⸻

Dimensional Access:

A craftable item allows controlled teleportation into these dimensions.
Usage is intentional — entry is not random.

⸻

Behavior:

non-standard spawn conditions
no predictable patterns
limited interaction
conditional despawn

⸻

Effects:

brief visual artifacts
irregular audio
lighting inconsistencies
UI anomalies

⸻

Technical:

Minecraft 1.20.1
Forge
Singleplayer focused

⸻

No explanation is provided for entities or dimensions.
